title: Cut 1,642,253 paid contact pairs after restoring chart 268
body:
## Mathematical result

Keep the C+D rebind at 182→0 and target the fixed 0→19 and 421→1 replacement routes. Directed cuts eliminate 1,642,253 of the 1,642,578 eligible old-contact pairs independently of coding and clocks. All 325 survivors fail a separate condition preserving a named first-reader value of the pre-retarget C+D word with frozen source stock. That condition need not preserve the same scalar as the original native word.

## Sources

Canonical main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15 and #8006 4035f150285513852cab8d00b8bfc233c699ea0a. #8008 and #8009 are the relevant funded-contact and literal old-value controls.

## Validation

All 32 hashes and five clean Python verifiers passed the cut roster, two directed caller prices and all 325 independent collision checks and restored-stock controls.

## Open next questions

Alter earlier source values, remove the named reader dependency, or change paid endpoints. The remaining narrow test leaves arbitrary other recoding open.
